notes: Specs are for the original RED KOMODO 6K (S35 sensor, RF mount, global shutter) — distinct from the newer KOMODO-X. Sourced from RED's official KOMODO Operation Guide (V2.1 Rev-A), hosted on RED's own docs.reddigitalcinema.com subdomain, cross-checked against the guide's "Technical Specifications" page (.../Content/C_TechSpecs/Specs_KOMODO_6K.htm). Ports intentionally omitted because no listed connector id fits and they are not standard signal/power connectors: (1) top "Accessory Port" — a proprietary spring-pin/pogo interface for the optional KOMODO Link Adaptor accessory, which itself breaks out to USB-C and Gigabit Ethernet — these are NOT native ports on the camera body, only available via that separate paid accessory; (2) Wi-Fi antenna — female RP-SMA connector; (3) CFast 2.0 media bay — storage card slot, not a cable connector; (4) bottom "Service Port" — RED-service-only, not user I/O; (5) built-in dual digital microphones (Mic 1/Mic 2) — internal elements, not external jacks. The 9-pin EXT and 2-pin DC-In ports use RED's proprietary "0B ODU" circular connector series (not literal DE-9 RS-232 or cylindrical DC barrel connectors); mapped to the closest available connector ids per instructions. Grade sdi-12g reflects the SDI port's maximum rated mode (12G-SDI); it also supports 6G/3G/1.5G-SDI fallback modes.

ports.name: External Mic Jack
ports.note: 3.5mm stereo external microphone input (left side of body).

ports.name: Headphone Jack
ports.note: 3.5mm stereo headphone monitor output (left side of body).

ports.name: 9-pin Extension Port (EXT)
ports.note: Proprietary 9-pin '0B ODU' circular connector combining Genlock In, Timecode In, GPIO, and RS-232 camera control (Ctrl) in one port; no exact match in the given connector list, approximated as rs232 since that is the named control signal.

ports.name: 12G-SDI
ports.note: Full-size BNC SDI monitor output; supports 12G/6G/3G/1.5G-SDI modes with SMPTE timecode, HANC metadata, and embedded 24-bit/48kHz audio. Output only (not genlock/timecode in).

ports.name: DC-In
ports.note: Proprietary 2-pin '0B ODU' circular DC power connector, wide input 7-17V DC. Not a literal cylindrical barrel jack, but the closest id in the given connector list.
